design_archetype: Electric & Neon / Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid (Tech Noir)
visual_enhancers: Tracing Beam Borders on Pricing Cards to indicate data/power flow
Kinetic Typography masks (reveal text line by line on scroll) in Hero
Subtle glassmorphism for fixed navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px border-b border-white/5
Neo-brutalist sharp edges: absolutely NO rounded-2xl or 3xl. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm.

layout_and_grids.general: Massive generous spacing. Sections separated by py-32 or py-48.
layout_and_grids.services_bento: Tetris Mode A: 12-column grid. Service cards spanning 4, 8, or full columns to create asymmetry.
layout_and_grids.manifesto_list: Brutalist block-level list. Huge JetBrains Mono numerals (e.g., 01, 02) aligned left, text pushed to the right. Use border-b border-white/10 to separate.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.details: Fixed glassmorphic top nav. Logo in Cabinet Grotesk, Links in JetBrains Mono. 'REQUEST QUOTE' button in neon cyan with sharp corners.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Kinetic text reveal (Framer Motion). Headline: 'WE BRING DEAD HARDWARE BACK TO LIFE.' Subtitle in JetBrains Mono. Dark imagery behind a bg-black/50 overlay.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.details: Massive Outline Text (text-8xl, font-black, text-transparent, border/stroke white/20). Moving extremely slowly: 'LOGIC BOARD REPAIR + DATA RECOVERY + THERMAL PASTE RENEWAL + VIRUS ERADICATION'.

sections.name: Manifesto (Process)
sections.details: Numbered list of chapters. '01 Diagnostics', '02 Surgery', '03 Stress Test'. Huge numbers, stark dividing lines.

sections.name: Services Grid
sections.details: Bento Grid layout (Tetris Mode A). Hovering over a card triggers a subtle blue glow (box-shadow) and image scale inside. Categories: General Repair, Virus Removal, Upgrades, Networking, Data Recovery.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.details: Minimalist technical cards. Focus on transparent pricing. No heavy gradients, just 1px borders.

sections.name: About
sections.details: Grayscale photography of technician typing. Emphasize trust, speed, and precision.

sections.name: Booking / Quote Form
sections.details: Shadcn UI forms customized for dark tech. Sharp input borders, neon cyan focus rings (focus:ring-[#00F0FF]).

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Massive typographic footer. 'LET'S FIX IT' at text-[10vw] filling the container.

image_urls.description: Blurry blue server lights, extremely moody and tech-focused.
Grayscale moody photo of hands typing on a laptop, professional and technical.
Dark gaming/custom rig with glowing teal ring lights.
Macro view of copper circuits, organic and technical.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory.
motion_and_interactions.kinetic_text: Framer Motion line-by-line reveal using overflow-hidden on wrappers, translating Y from 100% to 0%.
motion_and_interactions.bento_hover: Subtle scale (1.02) and translation, border color shift from border-white/5 to border-white/20, plus a faint Neon Cyan drop-shadow.

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00F0FF].
accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure white text on `#050505` background meets APCA standards. Overlay images heavily with `bg-black/60` to preserve text readability.

technical_requirements.note: Use standard .js and .jsx extensions. Do NOT generate TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) files.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use `Inter`, `Roboto`, or generic fonts. Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and JetBrains Mono for data/numbers.
Implement the background purely as black `#050505`, without muddy gradients.
The hero section MUST use a text masking technique (framer-motion) to reveal the title line-by-line as the user enters the page.
Ensure all buttons are sharp or barely rounded (rounded-sm maximum) to match the Brutalist Tech look.
Use standard Tailwind grid utilities for the bento layout. Ensure children are direct descendants to prevent breaking grid behavior.
Images MUST have heavy overlays (e.g. `bg-black/40` or `bg-black/60`) to sit behind text without ruining contrast.
The Manifesto section should have a massive JetBrains Mono number on the left (e.g. '01') and the description on the right.
Ensure the booking form uses Shadcn components but heavily modified with Tailwind classes to match the neon tech aesthetic (e.g., focus:ring-[#00F0FF]).
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key informative elements have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so write JavaScript React components without TypeScript types.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts. Asymmetry creates tension and interest.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Exclude transform from `transition-all`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-8, p-12, py-32 are your friends.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Only use the ones provided in `image_urls`.
No emojis for icons. Use the provided icon library (Lucide React).
